data.body: Fixed in change 3367, merged as 1fce28eaf9b (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1; make verify rc=0: 21,165 + 218 passed). build_drift already proved at handle resolution that the running build is a strict ancestor of the pinned ref, but only logged it. It now records the finding per pinned sha, and gate_source.annotate_result attaches it to any verdict whose model never ran (coverage.llm_ran false) as coverage.build_drift: build and pinned shas, commit distance, dirty flag, and a remedy naming the pinned ref and `make install`. The provider error stays verbatim. tests/unit/test_build_drift_degraded_verdict.py pairs a repo whose newer commit moves rebar.toml to a 5.5 model with a running build at the older commit and asserts the note and remedy; failed RED before the change. Negative cases: build at the pinned ref, a verdict whose model ran, and a local-source gate get no note. No config key, env var or flag.
